messages:
devon: Quick sync — aiming to cut the coordinated version roll across API/runtime/console/SDKs today. Holding cutoff at 20:00 UTC. Ping leads: @ana @chris @sara. Please confirm PRs and changelog entries by 19:00 so I can tag and start canaries.
nana: got it, will open the SDK semver bump PR now (package.json + CHANGELOG). aiming for #6123.
chris: runtime has one last perf hotfix in #4987 that needs a rebase against release/1.14. I can finish by 18:30 UTC, but if anyone depends on the current CI artifacts, heads up.
sara: console changelog queued, but we still need a short migration note about header auth change. dropping it in #3211 now, should be done by 17:45.
lucy: QA will run a focused regression suite after canary — please mark the canary image with tag 'canary-1.14.0' and push to staging. I can start tests at 20:05 UTC.
devon: thanks. two small requests: 1) SDK owners, make sure the generated clients include the new `model_selection` flag in docs; 2) release note snippets should be one-line bullets, we compile them into the public changelog.
nana: noted about `model_selection`, will regenerate and add docs snippet. linking draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/6123
chris: rebased #4987, kicked CI. runtime image will be `redwood/runtime:1.14.0-rc1` once green. one test flake to watch in r-tokens, but appears unrelated.
sara: changelog snippet added to #3211, migration note included. also left a comment for docs team to pick up the short copy.
devon: cool — when PRs are merged, reply here with the merge commit hash. I'll run the tagging commands: ```bash
git fetch origin && git checkout release/1.14 && git merge --no-ff <merge-sha> && git tag -a v1.14.0 -m "release v1.14.0"
git push origin v1.14.0
```
release-bot: auto: tag v1.14.0 created by devon at sha fc3a9b2 (release/1.14)
lucy: canary image deployed to staging, smoke passed. starting full regression now.
devon: rolling canaries to prod clusters in 10m if regressions are clean. final cutoff reminder: no new behavior PRs after 19:00 UTC — only critical fixes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
nana: merging SDK PR now. merging sha: a7f4d9c
sara: merged console PR, merge sha: d3b2e10
chris: runtime PR merged, merge sha: fc3a9b2
lucy: QA finished — 0 critical regressions, 2 minor UI diffs logged under ticket RED-4821.
devon: great ship. I'll finalize the public changelog and close the release checklist. thanks everyone :tada:
